changelog.title: Alpha is retired: this update switches it off
changelog.summary: This is the last Alpha release. It switches Alpha off. The 13 mods are replaced by placeholders that add nothing to the game, and nothing new has been added. Blocks that Alpha added turn into empty air, and once a world has been saved that way they do not come back. Back up your worlds before you update.
highlights: Alpha is switched off. The 13 mods are replaced by placeholders that add nothing to the game (Cherry, OUKA and Aureum are not touched)
Only the overworld's height limit (Y up to 1023) stays, so that nothing you built above Y=319 with ordinary blocks is deleted
Corvus removes the old jars, places the placeholders and keeps a backup of the files it replaced. If you installed by hand, or run a server, delete the old jars as the pack's README says
warnings: Back up your worlds first. Blocks that Alpha added turn into empty air when a world is opened without Alpha, and once it has been saved that way they are gone for good. Putting Alpha back does not restore them (checked on a dedicated server). Alpha's items and creatures are expected to go the same way (not tested)
A server and its players must move together: a player who still has Alpha cannot join a server that no longer does, and the other way round
If "Install updates automatically" is on in Corvus, this update is applied without asking. Corvus's backup covers the mods folder, not your worlds
known_limitations: Everything else Alpha had on this site has been removed: every earlier download, its recipes, and its install guide, gates, features, roadmap and known-issues pages. This entry is all that remains of its changelog.
