launcher_page.intro: Corvus is a small desktop app that keeps your mods up to date automatically. It checks this Wiki for the current release, downloads updates for you, and verifies every file it downloads against a SHA-256 checksum published here before it touches your mods folder. This Wiki is the only source it trusts.

sections.title: What it is, and why it exists
sections.body_html:
Keeping mods up to date by hand means re-visiting the Download page, comparing version numbers, downloading a new file, and putting it in the right folder every time a release ships. Corvus automates that: it reads this Wiki's release manifest, compares it against what you already have installed, and fetches only what's changed.

Every download the launcher makes is checked against a SHA-256 checksum published by this Wiki before it's used. If a downloaded file doesn't match, the launcher will not install it. The Wiki is the launcher's only source of truth for what the "current" release is.

sections.title: Installing Corvus
sections.body_html:
Corvus is available from the Download page on this Wiki in two forms:

  • Native installers (a Windows .msi, a macOS .dmg, a Linux .deb) — install like a normal desktop app, no Java required. These are not code-signed yet, so your OS will show a first-run warning: on macOS, right-click the app and choose Open instead of double-clicking; on Windows, click "More info" then "Run anyway" on the SmartScreen prompt.
  • The cross-platform jar, {launcher_jar} — the same file runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, but needs Java 25 or newer already installed. If double-clicking it doesn't open it, run java -jar {launcher_jar} from a terminal or command prompt in the folder you downloaded it to.

sections.title: Pointing it at an existing pack folder
sections.body_html: If you've already installed mods manually, you don't need to start over. On first run, the launcher lets you choose the folder your mods already live in instead of creating a new one. Point it at your existing mods folder and the launcher will treat that installation as the one it manages from then on.

sections.title: Automatic vs. manual update mode
sections.body_html:
In automatic mode, the launcher checks this Wiki's release manifest on its own and installs new versions as soon as they're available, so your pack folder stays current without you having to do anything.

In manual mode, the launcher still checks for updates, but waits for you to review and confirm before it downloads or installs anything — useful if you'd rather choose exactly when an update lands, for example to avoid interrupting a play session.

sections.title: Confirming an update actually applied
sections.body_html:
As of version 1.1.0, clicking Update writes the new mod files directly into your pack's mods folder, and the launcher will not show "Update complete" unless it has re-checked the folder afterwards and confirmed the expected files are really there. If something goes wrong partway through, it reports failure instead of a false success.

To see the change for yourself on macOS: open the folder shown under General (⌘+⇧+G in Finder, then paste the path), look inside mods, and check the version number in each cherry-*.jar filename before and after clicking Update.

If you're updating from a pack folder that was last touched by a launcher older than 1.1.0, the very first update may leave one old-versioned jar sitting alongside the new one for that mod (the launcher didn't yet have a record of which files it had previously placed). This clears up on its own from the next update onward. If it bothers you sooner, it's safe to delete the older-numbered cherry-*.jar by hand once the new one is confirmed present.

sections.title: Restoring from a backup if an update goes wrong
sections.body_html: If an update leaves your pack in a state you don't want — a mod misbehaving, or an update you'd rather undo — the launcher keeps a backup of your previous pack state so you can restore it. Use the launcher's restore option to roll your pack folder back to the backed-up version rather than trying to fix files by hand.

aureum_page.config_body: Every key in config/aureum.json can be switched off on its own. Turning one off means Aureum's bytecode changes for that feature are never applied at all — the strongest guarantee available if it ever conflicts with another mod.
aureum_page.closing_line: Aureum is a separate mod with its own version line, verified by SHA-256, updated independently.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK V1.7 55114 — Beacon repair, Artificial Sun helium-3, overclock x50, Battery Charging Socket
ouka.summary: The Beacon is repaired with a Tsubomi Nether Star Block, the Artificial Sun burns helium-3 as its own fuel, the overclock cap rises to x50, and the new Battery Charging Socket holds up to 200 SMES batteries.
highlights: An Ouka Beacon is repaired with 1 Tsubomi Nether Star Block. A Heavy Core Ingot no longer repairs it. Without Tsubomi there is no item to repair with, so it cannot be repaired.
The Artificial Sun burns helium-3 as a separate fuel, and very fast: on top of the power it delivers, it burns extra, more the harder it is driven (5x at full output, 1.4x at a tenth).

The overclock cap is raised to 5,000% (x50). There are 17 levels: x1.00 to x2.50 as before, then x3, x4, x5, x7.50, x10, x15, x20, x30, x40 and x50. Power per tick stays the square of the speed, so x50 draws 2,500 times the rated power. Combined with a Tachyon Accelerator, the cap rises from x10 to x50.

Battery Charging Socket: holds up to 200 SMES batteries in one block, 80 GJ of capacity and up to 20 MW per tick at 200 batteries. Right-click with a battery to put in everything you carry; sneak with both hands empty and right-click to take one out. Breaking it gives one item that keeps the batteries and their charge. It has no GUI; its status is shown in the action bar.
warnings: Before you install V1.7 55114, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

Not verified yet: the helium-3 figures are proven only by unit tests, with no real-client capture of the Artificial Sun. The beacon repair with the real Tsubomi item was not exercised in a world (the tests use a stand-in item). Worlds from 1.7.2.2 were not loaded end to end.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK 1.7.2.2 — Industrial Hazard Exoskeleton adjusted
ouka.summary: The Hazard Exoskeleton full set is softer: fall and fire damage are cut by 25%, and lava swimming is removed.
highlights: Wearing all 4 pieces, fall damage is cut by 25% (it was cancelled), and fire damage is cut by 25% (it was cancelled). You now burn. You can no longer swim in lava.
Shock (lightning) protection, armour and the 3x mining speed are unchanged.
warnings: Before you install 1.7.2.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2.1 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK 1.7.2.1 — Heavy Core Ingot and Block, and the OUKA Beacon rebalance
ouka.summary: A Heavy Core Ingot and a Heavy Core Block, and new numbers for the OUKA Beacon.
highlights: Heavy Core Ingot and Heavy Core Block are added. The OUKA Beacon is now repaired with 1 Heavy Core Ingot.
The OUKA Beacon wears 25% faster, loses 15% of its maximum durability, and its effect is 15% stronger. Its 1,000-block reach is unchanged.
warnings: Before you install 1.7.2.1, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK 1.7.2 — the Hollow Purple sphere and the lattice window recipe
ouka.summary: The Hollow Purple sphere renders the same on every graphics setting, and the lattice window has a new recipe.
highlights: The Hollow Purple sphere renders the same on every graphics setting, including over and under water. With Improved Transparency on, it no longer breaks up into a lattice.
The lattice window has a new recipe: birch planks and sticks in the pattern PSP / SPS / PSP make 2.
warnings: Before you install 1.7.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.1 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK 1.7.1 — the new name and a rebalanced OUKA Beacon
ouka.summary: Limitless is now called Ouka JJK. The OUKA Beacon is rebalanced: its blessings are a quarter as strong, its recipe needs two Heavy Cores, and it now wears out with use and is repaired with a Heavy Core.
highlights: Limitless is renamed Ouka JJK: the creative tab, the Controls category and the technique wheel use the new name. The techniques and items keep their names.

The OUKA Beacon's blessings are a quarter as strong as before; the range is unchanged. The terminal shows the new strength. Resistance no longer makes you immune, and fire immunity and full night vision need a higher level.
The OUKA Beacon's recipe needs two Heavy Cores, in the bottom corners.

The OUKA Beacon has durability. It wears faster the more players it blesses and the higher its levels are set, and stops when it breaks. Right-click it with a Heavy Core to repair it to full. The terminal shows how much is left, and a beacon keeps its durability when you pick it up.
warnings: With the graphics option Improved Transparency turned on (it is off by default), the Hollow Purple sphere is still drawn in front of water. This will be fixed in 1.7.2.

Before you install 1.7.1, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.0 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: Ouka JJK 1.7.0 — Infinity, the domains and the King of Curses
ouka.summary: OUKA brings in a complete set of sorcery: play as Gojo with Infinity, Lapse Blue, Reversal Red, Hollow Purple and the Infinite Void domain, or as Sukuna with Dismantle, Cleave, Open and the Malevolent Shrine. The weapons Kamutoke and Hiten, the Blindfold and the Character Guide come with it. It adds 10 items and 1 block, and carries everything from 1.6.2.2.
highlights: Gojo: Infinity stops what comes at you. Lapse Blue pulls the world in, Reversal Red throws it back, and the two meet as Hollow Purple. Expand the Infinite Void to trap everything inside its dome.
Sukuna: Dismantle and Cleave cut through what stands in front of you, Open sets the ground alight, and the Malevolent Shrine is a domain of its own. Kamutoke calls down lightning.
Switch abilities with R, use them with Z and V, and open the technique menu with C. The Character Guide, given once when you join, explains each technique.
The Domain Barrier is the wall of a domain: it cannot be broken or blown up. Domains can clash when two of them meet.
warnings: With the graphics option Improved Transparency turned on (it is off by default), the Hollow Purple sphere is drawn in front of water instead of behind it. This is a known issue and will be fixed in 1.7.1. With the option off, it is drawn correctly.
Going back to an earlier version after playing 1.7.0 removes the Domain Barrier and every Ouka JJK item (Kamutoke, Hiten, the Blindfold, the Character Guide and the 6 spawn eggs) from the world.

Before you install 1.7.0, remove the old OUKA jar (1.6.2.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.2.2 — furnace fuel, assembly materials and the hand-crank generator
ouka.summary: An industry update that also carries the 1.6.2.1 fixes. The Catalytic Smelting Furnace now smelts ore straight from the ground, the Automated Precision Assembly Line gains a materials store you fill before choosing a recipe, and the new Hand-Crank Generator brings OUKA power to pure survival. It adds 1 new block.
highlights: The Catalytic Smelting Furnace takes Raw Tungsten and Ancient Debris directly, without grinding them to dust first. It burns Argon Canisters from its own fuel slot, and hoppers feed fuel only into that slot.

The Automated Precision Assembly Line has a Materials tab. Put parts into its materials store from your inventory, then pick a recipe: if the store holds everything the recipe needs, the line builds it at once. A green bar in the recipe list marks what the store can build right now. Hoppers and conveyors still feed the intake as before.
The Hand-Crank Generator is made from vanilla items only. Hold right-click on it to turn the crank and send power to a nearby Tesla pylon, so even a hardcore world can power its first machines.

From 1.6.2.1: the Ouka Blessing effect icon stays, and hovering it in your inventory lists every blessing you have and how strong it is. Ryusei now explains a wrong placement or use, gives hints for operating the train, and tells riders why the train cannot stop at the next station.
warnings: Going back to an earlier version after playing removes the Hand-Crank Generator from the world.

Before you install 1.6.2.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.6.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.2 — the Ryusei maglev train
ouka.summary: A train update. The Ryusei maglev train runs on guideway you lay out, with stations, a dispatch console and a four-car train you can walk through. It adds 6 new items and 3 new blocks.
highlights: Link Guideway Nodes in order with the Ryusei Survey Transit. Each link reports the line's length, its tightest curve and the speed the line allows, and a curve or slope the train cannot take is refused.

Place a Stop Coil beside a linked guideway to make a station, then put a Dispatch Console nearby. Use a Consist Card on the console to set the train at that station, and start the shuttle between stations.
Ride the four-car train: sit in a seat, and walk the aisle while the train moves. The doors open only while the train is stopped at its station, and they stay locked while it moves.
The head car's cab shows the speed, the inverter frequency and the line voltage. If something stands in the guideway, the train waits short of it, and it never breaks blocks.
warnings: This version has no power blocks or power network yet. The voltage and frequency on the cab are for show only. Going back to the previous version after playing removes the Ryusei items and blocks from the world.

Before you install 1.6.2, remove the old OUKA jar from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.1 — the Spirit Vein, sorcery and Sigil Marks
ouka.summary: A Spirit Vein update. A Silver Rite Dagger opens your vein, and with it come the Phantom Blade Rain, Spirit Sight and ward marks. It adds 4 new items and 1 new block, the Sigil Mark.
highlights: Make the Silver Rite Dagger on the assembly line. Sneak and use it to perform the Blood Rite: it costs a little health and opens your spirit vein. When your health is low the rite is refused, and it never kills you.
Hold a Sigil Focus in your main hand and hold the Phantom Blade Rain key (default J): phantom blades fly far where you look, plant themselves and burst a moment later. Blades never break blocks.

Hold use with a Sight Lens to look through it, and press the Spirit Sight key (default U) to switch between Stillness Sight and Keen Sight. Keen Sight makes your OUKA guns and phantom blades hit weak points much harder.
Draw a Ward Chalk mark on top of a block, then pour spirit into it with a Sigil Focus, and Alarm, Siphon and Bulwark wards stand around it. Press the Vein Status key (default I) to read your spirit.
warnings: Wards trap no one and protect no blocks. The Bulwark ward stops damage from projectiles and explosions coming from outside. The Siphon ward drains health from players and creatures it has not been told to trust.

Before you install 1.6.1, remove the old OUKA jar from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.0.1 — clay, power draw ×2, and a gentler OUKA Beacon
ouka.summary: A small balance update. The stone synthesizer can make clay, every machine that runs on power draws more, and the OUKA Beacon is milder but cheaper to build. There are no new blocks or items.
highlights: The Volcanic-Hydraulic Cobblestone Synthesizer gains clay in its list of products: one clay block every 1.6 seconds. As with cobblestone and sand, the lava and water are not used up.
Every machine that runs on power now draws ×2. Generation and storage ratings are unchanged.
The OUKA Beacon's effects now stop at 5.00 instead of 20.00. Its radius of 1,000 blocks and its pedestal of 328 blocks are unchanged.
The OUKA Beacon is cheaper to craft: 2 beacons, 2 Ouka alloy blocks and 1 nether star (it used to take 4 beacons and 4 alloy blocks).
warnings: A factory built before this update runs half as many machines on the same supply. A machine short of power only stops and waits; nothing breaks and nothing inside is lost. A beacon that was set above the new limit reads as the limit when it loads.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.6.0.1, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install on both the client and the server.

ouka.title: The Grand Synthesis — closed sliding doors, 50 furnishings and 30 heavy machines
ouka.summary: The washitsu and the factory both grow. A closed row of shoji or fusuma no longer shows a gap of light between its doors: a meeting stile now covers each seam, and the new Shikii Grooved Hinoki Sill takes the foot of the doors. 50 new furnishings fill the room and the garden, and 30 heavy-industry machines lead from ore to ultrafine powder, silicon wafers and quantum chips, up to the Artificial Sun Core rated at 1.00 GW. Every new item explains its use in its tooltip.
highlights: The gap between closed sliding doors is closed. Each door on the back rail now carries a meeting stile at both ends that covers the seam with its neighbour. Calculated over the shipped models, no line of sight passes between the doors of a closed row at any viewing angle from 0 to 89 degrees from straight on.

The new Shikii Grooved Hinoki Sill lies under sliding doors: its 2 grooves take the foot of a shoji or fusuma so that no light passes beneath. It pairs with the kamoi above and is made at a crafting table.

More doors and windows: the Diamond-Lattice Shoji, the Yukimi Shoji with a glass pane that slides up and down, the Drum-Faced Fusuma, the Thousand-Slat Lattice Door, the Hemp-Leaf Kumiko Shoji and the Amado Storm Shutter all slide on the same rails as the doors you already have. The Misu Silk-Bordered Blind, the Lattice Window and the Round Window Frame join them.

For the room: the Tsuitate Standing Partition and the Two-Fold Pillow Screen; the Raden-Inlay Writing Desk, Staggered Tokonoma Shelves and Karin Single-Plank Stand, which display your items; the Irori Sunken Hearth and Hibachi Brazier, which you can light; the Pure-Gold Tea Kettle and the Jizai Hook and Iron Pot, which steam beside them; the Ozen Meal Tray and the Tokkuri and Sake Cups.

For the garden: Raked White Gravel with 8 raking patterns, standing stones, stepping stones, a moss mound, 2 kinds of bamboo fence, a brushwood gate, the Tsukubai Basin you can fill, the Kakei Bamboo Spout and the Suikinkutsu, which rings with falling drops. For festivals and seasons: the Chochin Paper Lantern, Glass Wind Bell, Kadomatsu New-Year Pine, Daruma Doll and Carp Streamer Pole. And 2 instruments you can really play: the Taiko Drum and the Koto.

Heavy industry gains 30 machines and 32 new materials. The Supersonic Jet Mill turns 1 iron, copper or gold ore into 6 ultrafine powder, and the Vacuum Sintering Furnace bakes the powder into the same number of ingots, using argon. Other machines make liquid oxygen, argon, deuterium, graphene, tungsten carbide, silicon wafers, micro circuit boards and quantum chips.

The Artificial Sun Core is a 7 × 7 × 7 power plant that sends up to 1.00 GW to the grid, burning Deuterium Cells or Helium-3 Canisters; the Gas-Centrifuge Tower can now make those canisters. The Molten Salt Exchanger Tower stores up to 2 GJ and the Industrial Flywheel Storage up to 8 GJ. The Forced-Draft Cooling Tower supplies cooling water, and the Plant Control Console lists the machines in range and can pause them all at once.

All 113 new items say what they are for in their tooltips. The 30 machines are built on the Automated Precision Assembly Line; the furnishings and the sill are made at a crafting table. 73 new sounds come with them.
warnings: The gap fix is about what you see through a closed row. The meeting stile is drawn only, so the crosshair and bullets still pass through the 3-pixel gap between the rails, as before (rounds already pass through shoji and fusuma). Slightly translucent washi paper, and a view through lattices and glass, are by design. A hairline crack can remain where a door meets a block, and a closed Amado Storm Shutter still lets light through. How open doors look was not part of the calculation.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.6.0, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6: two OUKA jars, or two GeckoLibs, will stop the game from starting. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer (Fabric API is not in the zip). Install on both the client and the server.

The 30 machines are built on the Automated Precision Assembly Line, not at a crafting table. Raw Tungsten comes only from the Sub-Crustal Thermal Bore; there is no tungsten ore block. Process gases and liquids are canister items, not fluid blocks. Some machines wait until the one they need of the Vacuum Pump, Gas Compressor, Coolant Circulation Pump or Cleanroom Fan-Filter Unit touches them, and the status line names what is missing. The Artificial Sun Core needs vacuum, coolant and fuel, and charges its capacitor from the grid before it ignites. 1.00 GW is its rated maximum: it generates only what the grid asks for. Nothing cooks on the Irori Sunken Hearth.

ouka.title: The Wrought Iron Sovereign — a 3.8-block guardian for the treasury
ouka.summary: The Wrought Iron Sovereign arrives: a 3.8-block armoured guardian that stands asleep like a statue until a player in survival or adventure mode comes within 8 blocks or strikes it. It comes with the Treasury Door and Treasury Master Key, the Sovereign Battleaxe, Wrought Plate armour, the Wrought Iron Statue block and 15 new synthesised sounds. The assembly line now builds exactly the product you choose.
highlights: The Wrought Iron Sovereign arrives: a 3.8-block armoured guardian with 300 health. It stands asleep like a statue until a player comes within 8 blocks or strikes it.

Awake, it turns aside gun rounds, arrows, blades, blasts and shock waves. While its axe is free it does so from every direction; while the axe is stuck, the front and sides still turn everything aside, and a piercing round stops at the boss instead of carrying on into whoever stands behind it.

Its overhead blow buries the axe in the ground for 3.5 seconds, and only then can its back be hurt: hits from behind count 5 times over, up to 100 damage per opening, so every fight takes at least 3 openings. The Susanoo anti-materiel round and the circle shock wave do a flat 60 from behind instead.
Defeating it always drops a Treasury Master Key, the Sovereign Battleaxe and 8 Wrought Plate Ingots.
The Treasury Door cannot be broken in survival and shrugs off explosions. Only the Treasury Master Key opens it, and the key is never used up. Operators place the doors.

The Sovereign Battleaxe hits for 13. Charged for 1.2 seconds, it releases a fan-shaped shock wave 6 blocks long that stuns for 2 seconds and breaks no block. 4 pieces of Wrought Plate armour together cancel knockback completely.
The Wrought Iron Statue is a 3 × 3 × 4 figure of the sleeping guardian, made on the assembly line. 15 new synthesised sounds carry the boss, the door, the key and the axe.

The Automated Precision Assembly Line now builds exactly the product you choose on a new selection screen. This fixes 16 products that used to come out as a different item, and its aiming outline now follows the machine's drawn shape.
warnings: Assembly lines placed before 1.5.0 start with nothing selected and wait: open each one with an empty hand, choose a product and press “Build this”. No parts, finished items, running jobs or power are lost, but a waiting line takes in no parts, so automated factories stand still until you choose.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.5.0, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6: two OUKA jars, or two GeckoLibs, will stop the game from starting. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer (Fabric API is not in the zip). Install on both the client and the server.

The Wrought Iron Sovereign does not spawn naturally: place it with its spawn egg or /summon. It does not vanish on Peaceful, and once woken it never goes back to sleep. The Treasury Master Key, the battleaxe and the ingots come only from the boss; a full armour set takes 18 ingots, which is 3 defeats. Only operators can place Treasury Doors. With the F3+B hitbox view, a sleeping boss can still be told from a statue.

ouka.title: The Kinetic Overdrive — 15 guns and a 35-block wind turbine
ouka.summary: OUKA GUN MAX arrives: 15 guns on 6 types of ammunition, each with its own recoil, reload and sound, and sights and parts that you fit at a mounting screen. Also a 35-block Type-W1 "Fujin" wind turbine, Operating Shelter glass in 7 colours, and OKE, a new animation runtime that drives the guns and the turbine and now also renders the Matter Transceiver. Every new sound is synthesised from scratch.
highlights: 15 guns, from the Type-01 "Kusanagi" carbine to the Type-50 "Susanoo" anti-materiel cannon. Each has its own handling, recoil spring, reload and sound.

6 types of ammunition. Hits land instantly out to 50 blocks; beyond that the round flies as a falling shot. Rounds pass through wooden doors, glass and iron bars, losing power, and never break blocks.

4 sights (reflex, holographic, a 2-4× variable scope and a thermal sight) and 10 functional parts (muzzle devices, grips, 3 magazines, a stock and a laser) change recoil, sound, magazine size and aim time. You fit them on the Z screen, which shows the gun's figures before and after.

Left click fires, right click aims, R reloads, F inspects the gun in your hand, N switches ammunition or energises the sniper rifle, B changes fire mode, K steps the scope, and sprint-then-sneak slides. Every gun key can be rebound under "OUKA GUN MAX".
Every gun sound is synthesised from scratch in 4 layers (mechanism, blast, reverb tail and a supersonic crack), and the reverb follows whether you are in the open, in a canyon or indoors.

The Type-W1 "Fujin" wind turbine stands 35 blocks tall from a single item, turns into the wind and pitches its blades to match what the OUKA power grid asks for, up to 1.0 MW. Minecraft has no wind, so OUKA works one out from the world seed, the time and the weather.

Operating Shelter glass comes in 7 colours. Only operators can place or break it, it withstands all explosions, and bullets never pass it. The Operating Shelter Block has a new armoured look with an indicator lamp: green for operators, red for everyone else. The glass is not in the creative tab; hand it out with /give.
OKE, the new animation runtime, drives the guns and the wind turbine and now renders the Matter Transceiver. This release also includes the fixes from V1.3.1.
warnings: Known limits in V1.4.0: only the Matter Transceiver runs on OKE so far (the other machines move over later in V1.4.x); the holographic attachment screen and the mounting animation come in V1.4.x; the wind turbine runs only in the Overworld. The new commands /ouka reload and /ouka mount are for operators.
When updating from an earlier version, remove the old OUKA jar (ouka-1.3.1+mc26.3.jar and so on) from the mods folder. Two OUKA jars will stop the game from starting.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

ouka.title: The shelter stays operator-only through blueprints, and the vault explains its layout
ouka.summary: The Holographic Circuit Blueprint let players who are not operators place the Operating Shelter Block (since V1.2.0). In V1.3.1 a blueprint leaves the shelter out for them. The Quantum-Compression Vault now also explains its layout, and when it is not complete its message lists the other wrong places too.
highlights: Through a blueprint, too, only operators can place the Operating Shelter Block. Every other block is built as before.

The Quantum-Compression Vault's description now gives its layout: I/O ports go in the centre of the floor and the centre of each side's second layer from the bottom, heat-resistant glass fills the middle 3×3 of each side (layers 3–5 from the bottom), and the inner 3×3×5 stays empty.
When the vault is not complete, its message now lists up to 6 more wrong places (it used to name only the first).
warnings: When updating from an earlier version, remove the old OUKA jar (ouka-1.3.0+mc26.3.jar and so on) from the mods folder. Two OUKA jars will stop the game from starting.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

ouka.title: The Washitsu Architectural Masterpiece — thirty pieces of a Japanese room, and a factory that runs itself
ouka.summary: Thirty pieces for a Japanese room, and ten facilities in the second industrial update. Tatami and engawa, shoji and fusuma, ranma and byobu, a chabudai and a tansu, a kakejiku, an incense burner, lanterns, a shishi-odoshi, a furin and a go board. For the factory: a transceiver that sends items through walls, a miner that digs with your tool, a bus that draws straight from the vault, and more. Every new sound is synthesised from scratch.
highlights: Tatami: an igusa mat covers 2 blocks with one of 4 borders, and standing in a room of 8 or more joined cells makes hunger drain half as fast. Borderless checkered tatami laid together form a checkerboard.
Shoji and fusuma: an empty hand or a redstone signal slides them about one block open, and two side by side slide past each other. Four fusuma in a row make one gold-leaf landscape.

Kamoi and nageshi lintels: a carved ranma fits on top, and a kakejiku, a sword stand, a noren, a sudare or a furin hangs from them. The noren parts on the side you walk through; up to 3 sudare roll as one.

Furniture: sit on a zabuton or a zaisu, set out up to 4 things on a chabudai, and keep 27 stacks in a tansu. Whisk and drink matcha for full health and Haste II for 3 minutes (one bowl every 5 minutes).

Tokonoma and garden: the kakejiku's painting follows the seasons, a new one every 8 in-game days, and the yukimi-toro gathers snow in winter. The shishi-odoshi strikes its stone every 4.4 seconds; the furin rings in the wind.

The OUKA Matter Transceiver: link it with a Resonance Linker and it sends up to a stack and a bucket every tick, through walls, up to 32 blocks away, from one sender to as many as four receivers. No power needed.
The Resonant Miner digs with the pickaxe or shovel you give it and, at normal speed, takes as long as that tool would take you. Silk Touch and Fortune work too. An area of up to 5×5, up to 16 deep.
The Quantum Vault I/O Bus draws the items you choose (up to 9 kinds) from the vault, up to 256 a tick, and leaves the count you set inside. An OUKA conveyor takes only 1 a tick.

The Hyper-Impulse Hopper moves 64 items a tick into a chest or pipe (1 onto an OUKA conveyor). The Cobblestone Synthesizer never uses up the bucket of lava and the bucket of water you give it, and, on grid power, makes cobblestone, gravel, sand or ore sand.

Also: a 3×3 crafter, a pump and pipes that move 8 buckets of fluid a tick, a grinder that stores experience in capsules, a terminal that opens the vault even from another dimension, and an accelerator pylon that speeds OUKA machines up to ×10.
warnings: This release fixes two sounds that never played in V1.0.1, V1.1.0 or V1.2.0: the OUKA Beacon terminal's slider tick and the Ouka Caster selector's confirm sound. If you are on an earlier version, please replace it.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

ouka.title: The Heavy Industrial & Kinematics Epoch — heavy industry you can watch at work
ouka.summary: Twenty pieces of heavy industry: a power grid and power stations, a vast vault, conveyor and drone logistics, smelting and processing, mining and automatic harvesting, and field tools with a hazard exoskeleton. No machine is a box where numbers go up: arms, hammers, drills and rotors really move, and each machine sounds as hard as it works. This release also fixes V1.1.0's two defects.
highlights: A power grid: Tesla pylons link without wires within 64 blocks, and arcs run from them to the machines. No cables.
Power stations and storage: a fission core (up to 2 MW; it scrams at 800 °C and never explodes), a solar tower that keeps running at night on stored heat, and a 400 MJ superconducting battery.
The Quantum-Compression Vault: build the 5×5×7 shell and it holds up to 2,147,483,647 items, searchable by name or by "@mod".
Maglev conveyors carry 20 items a second. Their shape follows their neighbours, you see every item riding them, nothing falls off, and a blocked line queues. Plus a splitter and a six-way sorter.
Logistics drones: link two ports with a route card and a drone ferries loads between them — even through unloaded areas, arriving after the flight time.

Smelting and processing: an arc foundry that smelts 32 ores at sixteen times furnace speed, a hydraulic crusher for double dusts and plates, an assembly line whose three arms weld, and a centrifuge that draws out titanium, lithium and helium-3.

Mining and harvesting: a bore that digs ore and crude oil without end and without breaking bedrock, a desalinator that pumps 200 buckets a second, a timber mill that fells, planks and replants, and a culture vat.
The Omni-Wrench (turn machines round, open and close exits, overclock up to ×2.50) and the Demolition Laser (a machine and everything in it back in your inventory in one second).
The Holographic Blueprint: record up to 16 blocks a side, check the life-size hologram, then build it from the items you carry.
The Hazard Exoskeleton: shocks, heat and falls no longer hurt, you can swim in lava, and you mine three times as fast.
warnings: This release fixes V1.1.0's two defects (a mined Block of Ouka Alloy dropped nothing; the shelter's loot table). If you are on V1.1.0, please replace it.
You can also install it from Corvus: the first time, press Download in Corvus; after that, Corvus replaces it with newer versions. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

ouka.title: The Operating Shelter — bedrock for the operator alone
ouka.summary: A block that only an operator can place or break. No explosion, no mob and no creative-mode break touches it. This release also adds seventeen sounds made from nothing, puts every recipe in the recipe book from the start, and fixes the crash in V1.0.0.
highlights: The Operating Shelter Block: only a player with operator permission can place or break it. Nobody else can, in any game mode.
No explosion gets through — Alpha's nuclear weapons, its other warheads and rockets, and TNT alike.
An ordinary player cannot break it in creative either. Creative's instant break ignores hardness, so that path is closed separately.
The wither, the ender dragon, an enderman carrying it away, a piston — none of them touch it. It sits in all eleven tags vanilla puts bedrock in.
An operator mines it normally in survival and gets it back (a diamond pickaxe or better).
When anyone else touches it, a hexagonal energy lattice snaps across the block's faces, with a metallic repulsion and sparks.
Seventeen sounds, every one made from nothing. No sound from another game, no sample library, no recording.
Twelve colours are twelve semitones: each circle colour sounds at its own pitch, so you can hear which one flew.
Every recipe is in the recipe book from the start. In V1.0.0 the unlock condition was too strict and nothing appeared.
The shelter is crafted from 4 obsidian, 4 netherite ingots and 1 block of Ouka alloy, for 2.
warnings: If you are on V1.0.0, please replace it. V1.0.0 crashes the game the moment a circle projectile comes into view, when "Improved Transparency" is on in Video Settings.
Install from the OUKA page. Corvus shows OUKA's changelog but does not install OUKA.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

ouka.title: The Apex Artifact — an altar, and danmaku in twelve colours
ouka.summary: OUKA's first release: a mod for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric), separate from Alpha and Cherry. Raise an altar on its pedestal and every player within 1,000 blocks receives its effects, and two items fire circle projectiles in twelve colours.
highlights: The OUKA Beacon: a 3×3×3 structure. Breaking any part removes all 27 and drops one beacon carrying its tuning.
A 328-block pedestal of netherite, diamond, emerald or Ouka alloy in eight layers. It wakes only when all 328 are there.
A 1,000-block aura that reaches players even while the beacon's own area is unloaded. Spectators receive nothing.
Ten effects tuned steplessly from 0.00 to 20.00: speed, mining, attack speed, strength, jump, safe fall, absorption, regeneration, food, resistance and night vision.
The constant effects of an enchanted golden apple, for as long as the aura reaches you — they return after death while the altar stands.
A frosted-glass terminal: right-click to open, then drag, or use the wheel in steps of 0.1, or 0.01 with Shift. Three presets.
Only the player who placed it, or an operator, may change it, and only from within 8 blocks. Everyone else sees it read-only.
Twelve colours of circle, each with its own effect: a freeze, a pull, a line that pierces walls, a split into two homing circles, and one that cycles the other eleven.
Five trajectories: straight, spiral, converging twelve onto the point you look at, an orbital guard of eight, and homing.
The shockwave on impact: a flat ring erases the enemies it crosses. Bosses take 20% of their maximum health. Allies and blocks are untouched.
warnings: One colour flashes the screen white on impact (Celestial White). It does not flash if Minecraft's "Hide Lightning Flashes" setting is on.
Install from the OUKA page. Corvus shows OUKA's changelog but does not install OUKA.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

cherry.title: The Lunar Genesis Update — from the launch pad to the Moon
cherry.summary: Cherry's first release: a separate mod brand that installs beside Alpha. Build the Launch Pad Complex, fly the Cherry Apex-1 to the Moon, and come home again.
highlights: The Moon: a new dimension with craters, ore deposits and Helium-3 Geysers, and a clock of its own.
Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex: board the docked rocket, hold jump through the countdown, and fly from the Overworld to the Moon and back to the pad with the pilot aboard.
Lunar rules: gravity is one sixth, and the vacuum takes 15% of maximum health through any armour except the Pressure Suit. Inside a Pressure Field Projector's sphere you are safe.
Overdrive Fusion: in the Resonance Crucible, an overdriven weapon, tool or armour piece gets ×3 attack damage, armour, toughness or mining speed.
Lunar resources: the Ultrasonic Cutter extracts Regolith Core Deposits only while in resonance, and the Cryo Canister captures Helium-3 only while a geyser is erupting.
Micrometeorites strike the lunar surface and leave craters.
Two skills: Dimensional Cleave (300% damage along its cross only) and Astral Lift, flight with an overdriven chestplate.
Checked to start alongside all 13 Alpha 4.4.0 mods with no mixin conflicts.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later, Fabric API 0.154.2 or later, GeckoLib 5.5.5 or later, and Java 25.

cherry.title: Now on Minecraft 26.3
cherry.summary: Cherry now runs on Minecraft 26.3. Everything from V1.0.0 comes along, and on a Moon you have already visited, newly generated ground meets the old.
highlights: Everything V1.0.0 added runs on Minecraft 26.3: the Moon, the Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex, the lunar rules, Overdrive Fusion, the lunar resources, Micrometeorites and both skills.
Worlds from V1.0.0 carry on: on the Moon, newly generated ground gets the same terrain and the same craters as V1.0.0, so it meets the ground you have already explored.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or later, Fabric API 0.161.0 or later, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or later, and Java 25.

cherry.title: The Aerospace & Naval Update — into the air and out to sea
cherry.summary: Cherry gains aircraft, airports and ships. You can walk about on a flying aircraft or a ship under way.
highlights: Two aircraft: the Cherry Stratos-900 passenger and freight ferry and the Cherry Aegis-X stealth fighter, with a first-person cockpit, artificial horizon and reticle, retracting gear, flaps and afterburner.

Airport fittings: PAPI lights that change colour with your approach angle, a catapult to launch an aircraft, an arresting wire that catches a lowered tail hook, and a control radar that shows the aircraft around it.

Two ships: the 48 m Cherry Leviathan-Class ocean car ferry and the 64 m Cherry Dreadnought-Class guided missile destroyer. Put one on the water, take the wheel to steer, or lay a route at the chart table and she will sail it, keeping clear of shallows.

Only the Dreadnought-Class is armed: a 406 mm railgun turret that trains and elevates independently and rocks the hull when it fires, and a VLS that launches only once its hatch is fully open. The car ferry carries no armament.
Deck walking: run and jump about on a moving aircraft or ship. The deck under you carries you with it.
A ship goes back into your hand when she is stopped and nobody is on her deck. She remembers the damage she took, so putting her back on the water does not mend her.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: Fixed: the afterburner no longer crashes the game
cherry.summary: With the video setting “Improved Transparency” turned on, lighting the Cherry Aegis-X’s afterburner crashed the game. It no longer does.
highlights: With “Improved Transparency” on, lighting the afterburner in flight (Z by default) no longer crashes the game, and its shock diamonds still show through the canopy from the cockpit.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: The ships, finished: real models, working stations and the ferry's doors
cherry.summary: The Leviathan and the Dreadnought get their real models and interiors, and every station aboard now works from the game. In 1.1.0 and 1.1.1 the railgun, the VLS and the chart table could not actually be used; now they can.
highlights: Real ships: hulls, decks and interiors are fully modelled — the ferry's vehicle deck, lounge, observation deck and bridge, and the destroyer's bridge, CIC and hangar — with windows you can see through that light up at night. Every deck you see is a deck you can walk on.

Stations: stand at the wheel, the chart table, or the destroyer's gunnery or sonar station and press the station key (H by default) to take it. The chart table opens a chart you click to lay a route on; the new sonar station shows contacts on a sweeping scope.

The Dreadnought now carries two triple 406 mm railgun turrets. Both train on the point you look at and fire one salvo on a left click, with muzzle flashes, blast rings, tracers and recoiling barrels. A right click fires the VLS at the radar-locked target once its hatch is open, venting white smoke.

The Leviathan's bow visor and bow and stern ramps: stopped at the wheel, press the doors key (' by default). The visor rises before the ramp lowers, the engine stays locked until everything is shut again, and you can walk up the lowered ramps.
Wake and bubbles: a ship under way throws a bow wave at the Kelvin angle and leaves a wake behind her, and a turning screw churns bubbles.

The helm keys no longer clash with Minecraft's own keys: , and . turn the wheel, = and - set the engine, and ; holds the heading. The helm instruments now sit above the hotbar and health bar instead of on top of them.
warnings: The helm keys have new names, so a binding you changed for them in 1.1.0 or 1.1.1 is not carried over. Set it again.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: Easy controls, and the railgun hits
cherry.summary: Flying and sailing are rebuilt so that anyone can do it. The view is no longer locked: the aircraft fly where you look, and the ships answer to W, A, S and D like a boat. The Dreadnought's railgun now strikes what it hits; in 1.1.0 to 1.1.2 its shells damaged nothing.
highlights: Aircraft fly where you look: turn your head and the Stratos-900 or the Aegis-X banks, turns, climbs or dives towards it by herself. W and S set the throttle; left-click fires the Aegis-X's missiles at the target the radar picks by itself.
Flaps, landing gear, brakes, reverse thrust, the afterburner, the canopy and the arresting hook now work by themselves, and a short guide on the screen shows the controls when you board.
The view is yours: it no longer locks to first person or tilts with the aircraft, F5 works in flight, and holding Left Alt lets you look around while she keeps her course.

Ships: standing at a station shows the key that takes it. At the wheel, W and S drive the engine (astern below zero), A and D steer, and letting go centres the wheel and holds her heading; Sneak leaves. The ferry's doors are on Y.
With nobody at the gunnery console, the Dreadnought's helmsman fires the guns from the wheel: left-click for a salvo, right-click for the VLS.

Fixed from 1.1.2: the rudder turned the ship the opposite way to its keys, astern gave no thrust, a ship could not be launched from the shore (she now floats with her stern just past the water you aim at), and a ship could not be picked back up in survival.

The railgun's shells burst on the first block, creature, ship or aircraft in their path and damage what lies within 4 m; when a salvo lands on one target, all six shells count. Look at any part of a hull and both turrets train on that point.
The gun spares the ship that fired it and her crew, and it never breaks blocks. No ship or aircraft is sunk or brought down by a single salvo, and manning the guns no longer loads distant chunks.
A death message from one of Cherry's weapons no longer shows an untranslated key when the attacker holds a renamed item.

The Aegis-X's missile count at the bottom left of the flight display is no longer cut off by the bottom of the screen. With the automatic GUI scale this happened at many screen sizes, among them 720p, 1440p, 4K and the game's default window.
Chart waypoints are accepted only within the chart's widest view, about 1.4 km from the ship, which also protects servers from malformed waypoint requests.
warnings: The controls have changed: 1.1.2's flight keys (R, U, Y, K, Z, N, M, J and the arrow keys) and helm keys (, . = - ; ') are gone, and any of them you rebound are no longer used.
Railgun shells now hurt whatever they strike, including other players' ships and aircraft. The crew member directing the guns is credited with the damage.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: Sounds come back after an audio device change
cherry.summary: When the audio device changes (earphones plugged in or out, or a device chosen in the options), the game restarts its sound engine and drops every looping sound. In 1.1.0 to 1.1.3, Cherry's aircraft engines, afterburner, missile motors and lock tones, and the pressure suit's breathing, then stayed silent until you boarded again or put the helmet back on. They now start again by themselves.
highlights: After an audio device change, the Stratos-900 and Aegis-X engines, the Aegis-X afterburner, missile motors and the lock tones start again by themselves within a moment.
On the Moon, the pressure suit's breathing does the same.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: Guns, Moon life, Lunaris Prime and Mars
cherry.summary: Cherry's biggest update: five next-generation guns with first-person animation and recoil, three kinds of life on the Moon, the boss Lunaris Prime sealed in a ruin far out on the Moon, the red planet Mars with its cold and iron dust storms, a navigation console that flies the Apex-1 to any of three worlds, and the Advanced Cherry Fabricator, which makes every gun, magazine and vehicle part.
highlights: Five guns: the CR-14 bullpup rifle, the CP-9 sub-machine gun, the CS-50 rail sniper, the CX-12 magpulse shotgun and the C-Pistol. Right-click aims and softly blurs what lies nearer and farther than your aim, R reloads (in survival with one of that gun's magazines) and F inspects; with recoil, muzzle flash, casings, holographic sights, the CS-50's 6× thermal scope and the C-Pistol's laser sight.

Life on the Moon: the Selenite Stalker hides under the regolith, leaps at anyone who walks without sneaking and bites holes in pressure suits; the Void Drifter's EMP blanks your guns' sights and ammo readouts; the Regolith Devourer slams the ground to fling you high into the sky and hurls molten meteors.

Lunaris Prime: beyond 8,000 blocks on the Moon a giant crater holds the Astraea Shackle (/locate finds it). An Astral Catalyst in its seal console wakes the boss; the sky turns crimson, and at half health its armour flies off for a second, faster phase.
Its relics: the Coreshard of Lunaris, the Graviton Siphon (its shot opens a black hole) and the Crown of Selene.

Mars: press launch on the pad to open the Apex-1's Stellar Navigation console and pick Earth, the Moon or Mars. Mars has 0.38 g and unbreathable air at -60 C: the pressure suit keeps the air out, and a Thermal Lining sewn in at the smithing table keeps the cold out.
Iron dust storms blow over Mars about every 20 minutes: the fog closes to a few blocks and noise crosses Cherry's HUDs.
Mars's resources: Martian Ferrite and Perchlorate Energy Salt. Perchlorate Propellant is rocket fuel worth three canisters.

The Advanced Cherry Fabricator: pick a recipe and fill its six inputs; it makes the guns, their magazines, gun parts, fuel and every vehicle, building the Apex-1 from boosters and the Dreadnought from railgun barrels that it mass-produces from helium-3 and regolith cores; hoppers can feed it.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

cherry.title: Guards, robots, turrets and transit
cherry.summary: Cherry's base-defence and transit update: villages keep guard villagers, a security terminal and robot protect your own base, an automatic turret fires whichever Cherry gun you mount in it, and a glass elevator, a heavy cargo lift and an escalator carry you, your cargo and your vehicles. The robot, the terminal, the turret and both lifts run on power: a redstone signal, or, with OUKA V1.2 or later installed, OUKA's grid.
highlights: Guard villagers: the first time a player comes near a village that has a bell, a bed and a villager, it is given 2 guards (3 with ten or more beds, 4 with twenty or more). They carry a halberd, a crossbow and a shield, fight hostile mobs within 16 blocks, back away from creepers and shoot them from a distance, and one replacement arrives every 5 minutes while the village is below its quota.

Guards turn on a player only after that player has hurt a villager or a guard, and let go 2 minutes after the last offence. They never fight each other, villagers or golems, and they never turn on a player in Peaceful.

The Security Terminal and the Security Robot: whoever places a terminal is its administrator, and right-clicking it enrols the nearest player within 2.5 blocks. A robot linked to a terminal patrols within 12 blocks of its post and, at any unregistered player it sees within 16 blocks, sounds a siren, warns for 2 seconds and then fires its stun rifle every 1.5 seconds: 2 damage and a 3-second stun. Registered players, guards, and players in Creative or Spectator are never stunned.

The robot's stun rifle runs on a 400 kJ battery that holds 20 shots. The robot recharges within 16 blocks of its terminal while the terminal holds energy, and the terminal fills from a redstone signal beside it. An empty robot still sounds the siren and aims, but holds fire until it is charged. With OUKA V1.2 or later installed, a robot or terminal within an OUKA pylon's reach also charges from OUKA's grid.

The Automatic Turret mounts on a ceiling, a wall or a floor and turns through 360 degrees. Put one Cherry gun in it and feed it that gun's magazines (a hopper works): it then tracks hostile mobs, and angered neutral mobs, within 32 blocks or the gun's range, whichever is shorter, and fires at that gun's own rate with its own sound. It never shoots players, villagers, guards, robots, golems or pets. Only its owner and operators can open or break it, and a broken turret keeps its gun, its reserve and its aim.

Power for the turret, the glass elevator, the cargo lift, the terminal and the robot comes from a redstone signal beside the device (beside the controller, for a lift), and that is all a game without OUKA needs. With OUKA V1.2 or later installed, a device within an OUKA pylon's reach (64 blocks) otherwise draws from OUKA's grid, including its SMES batteries. A device without power says what it is waiting for.

The Aero-Glass High-Speed Elevator: a 3x3 glass cabin on a controller and a maglev rail column, in a shaft you build up to 128 blocks tall. It cruises at up to 16 blocks a second with a smooth start and stop, rings a chime on arrival and opens its doors a moment later. Pick a floor on the holographic panel in the cabin or at the call button on a landing; the doors reopen if someone stands in them, and a landing door never opens onto an empty shaft. Closed, the cabin keeps the air in on the Moon and the cold out on Mars.

The Titan-Hydraulic Heavy Cargo Lift: a square platform from 3x3 to 7x7 blocks on scissor legs over a pit you frame, rising up to 24 blocks at 2 blocks a second. Yellow-black gates close around it and an amber beacon spins while it moves. It carries you, chest minecarts and boats, and Cherry vehicles that fit on the platform, parked while it moves, and it stops and returns if something is in the way. A pedestal on the platform and a call button at each landing run it; so does redstone.

The Kinetic Modular Escalator: two landings, a truss module for each column and a control panel make a 30 degree, 45 degree or flat run of up to 32 blocks (longer ones chain through landings). You stand on the moving steps, which travel at 4 blocks a second, and a redstone signal reverses it. It needs no power. On ships and aircraft, which share the same moving-deck physics, a rider who steps or jumps off now leaves at once, and sneaking on a moving deck walks instead of freezing.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

The turret, the glass elevator, the cargo lift, the security terminal and the robot's rifle do nothing without power: a redstone signal beside the device or, with OUKA V1.2 or later installed, an OUKA pylon's reach. Cherry works without OUKA, and redstone remains its only source then.

cherry.title: HoyoBrainrot
cherry.summary: A cosmetic update: a built-in resource pack, HoyoBrainrot, made by Corvus Dev. Name a Totem of Undying at an anvil and its icon becomes an animated picture. Nothing about how the game plays changes.
highlights: Name a Totem of Undying at an anvil with one of the names below and its icon turns into an animated character picture: in the hotbar, in the inventory and in your hand. A totem with no name, or with a name not on the list, looks as before.

Names: evernight, stelle, breakdance, lucia, nefer, march7, gerta, jahoda, cipher, yunli, black swan, ica, vivian, the gerta, nekomata, soukaku draw, soukaku picture, ju fufu, harumasa. Capitalised spellings and a few variants such as "march 7th" work too.
When a totem pops, you hear this pack's sound instead of the vanilla one.
The pack is on from the start. To switch it off, take HoyoBrainrot out in Options, Resource Packs: the totem's picture and sound go back to vanilla.
The jar is about 23 MB larger. The pack was made by Corvus Dev.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.
This update changes the sound of every totem pop for every player until the pack is switched off in Resource Packs.

aureum.title: First release — memory savings that stay out of chunk rendering
aureum.summary: A separate optimisation mod for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric), apart from Alpha. It works on game logic, memory and the server tick, never touches chunk rendering, and so runs beside Sodium and the Alpha pack. For higher FPS, install Sodium.
highlights: Shared block-state caches and a lighter thread-contention detector: 6.3 MB less resident heap with 2,209 chunks loaded (two independent measurements agree).
An expiry time for the structure template cache: 17.2 MB less heap while generating new land (two measurements agree). Unsaved templates in a structure block are never dropped.
Each optimisation can be switched off on its own in config/aureum.json, and a switched-off item leaves vanilla code untouched.
/aureum (needs permission) shows what is enabled and how much is being shared.
warnings: Tick time (MSPT) is unchanged within measurement noise; Aureum makes no speed claim.
The two client-side settings (a particle limit and a block-entity render distance cap) are off by default, and their effect has not been measured.
Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later, Fabric API, and Java 25 or later.

astraea.title: The Celestial Sovereign & Blade Genesis — ASTRAEA's first release
astraea.summary: ASTRAEA's first release: five blast doors that open like machines, three locks with lockpicking at hand, five Celestial tools beyond netherite, and the Celestial Blade — drawn, swung, parried and sheathed, with phantom starlight blades, a style rank and a soul forge.
highlights: Five blast doors (3×3 and 2×3) that open by hand or by redstone: an iris of six spiralling blades, a hydraulic double gate, a laser-grid hatch, a cryo door that breaks its seal in a burst of steam, and an astrolabe gate whose three rings align before its barrier dissolves into light.

Three locks for doors, trapdoors, fence gates, chests and barrels: a padlock with its own numbered key, a combination lock with a 4-digit PIN and a lock-out that doubles up to 5 minutes, and a biometric lock that lets in only enrolled people and keycards. Only the owner can break a locked block, and redstone and hoppers do not get through.
Lockpicking at hand: the tension wrench in your left hand, the pick in your right. Find the angle by the clicks; force a cylinder that will not turn and the pick bends and snaps.

The Celestial alloy and five tools with 4,500 uses: a pickaxe that mines 1×1, 3×3 or 5×5 (V) straight into your inventory, an axe that fells whole trees and breaks shields, a shovel that levels 5×5, a hoe that tills and harvests 5×5, and a spear that dashes and throws a spear of light.

The Celestial Blade: attack draws it and cuts — four cuts on the ground, three in the air and a diving helm-splitter; use to parry; stand still and it is sheathed, and every foe it struck is cut again, three times. The great strikes split the screen along a line.
Phantom starlight blades: lock on with V or the middle mouse button and eight blades of light follow your cuts; R calls Spiral Drive and Blistering Rain.
A style rank from D to SSS. At SSS, the sovereign awakening: blade tempo ×1.5, movement +30 %, attack speed +50 % and half damage taken.

The Celestial Forge: every defeat pours soul energy into the blade. At a smithing table, mend it, temper it up to 20 times (+2.5 % a level; the twentieth makes a named blade), and unlock three secret arts at 50, 200 and 500 defeats.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed.
Tested together with Cherry 1.2.0. Installing it together with Alpha is not supported.
/astraeabench measures your frame rate with 32 phantom blades and a space cut every second.

astraea.title: The Cyber-Relics & Mythic Pedestals
astraea.summary: A security suite powered by OUKA's grid — lasers, cameras and the Corvus Book Pro that shows their live view — the Plasma Saber, and two swords that are never crafted: Excalibur and Muramasa, drawn from their pedestals by your own hand.
highlights: Security Laser: an invisible tripwire that raises a redstone signal and an alert, or a crimson lethal beam (10 damage a second). Optical Prisms turn a beam 90° to build a grid. It spares its owner and the players they trust, and breaks no block.

Security Camera and Corvus Book Pro: cameras follow what moves; the laptop's CorvusOS shows each linked camera's real view, turns it, switches night and thermal views, graphs OUKA's power, switches laser modes, locks and unlocks electronic locks, and edits your trust list.

Plasma Saber: use ignites the blade; its hum rises with every turn and swing. Swing as a shot arrives and the arrow, trident or fireball goes back to whoever loosed it. Six Saber Crystals change its colour at the Diamond Polishing Bench.

Excalibur: place the Hallowed Anvil Pedestal at Y 180 or higher under the open midday sky, then hold use for three seconds to draw it. Hold and release for the Excalibur Ray (50 blocks, 5 wide, stopped by walls); while it is in your hand, you and those you trust have Regeneration II and Resistance II.

Muramasa: place the Blood-Bound Shrine at Y 0 or deeper in darkness; drawing it costs half your maximum health. It fights with the Celestial Blade's controls, returns a fifth of the damage it deals as health, and its sheathing cleave ignores armour.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. OUKA 1.3.1 or newer is optional: with it the security devices draw power within 64 blocks of a Tesla Pylon; without it they are always powered.
Tested together with Cherry 1.2.0 and OUKA 1.3.1. Installing it together with Alpha is not supported. A camera shows a picture only while it is inside your loaded area.

astraea.title: The 49 Sovereign Implementations
astraea.summary: Forty-nine systems on top of V1.0 and V1.1: a 9 × 9 crafting bench and its armour, rockets to the Moon and Mars, war machines and tunable cars, a fission plant, a refinery, pneumatic tubes and drones, mythic bosses, a hundred furnishings, and a Codex that tells you what anything is made of.
highlights: Oracle Crucible and Zenith gear: a 9 × 9 bench and the Core Press make the Zenith armour and the Zenith Cutter. Seven accessory slots (H) take rings, a necklace, a belt, a charm, a cloak and the Sovereign Crown.

Cosmic Frontier: the Apex Rocket flies to the Orbital Station, the Moon and Mars — worlds with no air and low gravity, where a Life-Support Unit fills a sealed room and the rock holds iron, copper and gold ore.

Machines: an armoured car and a biplane, a chassis you fit with an engine, tyres and a ram bumper and that tows minecarts, a fission plant, a four-stage refinery (one ore, five ingots), aero-tubes and a pressure drone that carries cargo between pads.

Codex of Creation: every item in the game in one searchable screen; choose one and see the tree of what it is made of, all the way down to raw materials. Three mythic bosses — the Steel Guardian, the Sunlit Chieftain and the Frostfield Behemoth — each called with its sigil; every move is shown on the ground and in the body before it lands, and each boss grows fiercer through three phases.

Celestial Blade Engine V2, "Kamui": sheathe at style rank SSS and every foe within 12 blocks is held, then cut nine times. The Plasma Saber now turns shots back like a mirror; a held torch or lit saber lights the ground round you.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. OUKA is optional. Tested together with Cherry 1.2.0 and OUKA 1.3.1; installing it together with Alpha is not supported. Every system and each of the nineteen conveniences can be switched off in config/astraea-sovereign.json.

Not in this version: bodies do not bend at joints (they lean, leap and fall); held light does not light creatures, and there are no water reflections or normal maps; pistons do not move chests. Also fixed: in first person the Celestial Blade and Muramasa no longer show a second sword, and blocks now obey their drop rules in explosions.

astraea.title: Heavy Industry
astraea.summary: The industrial machines are rebuilt at the size of real plant — an arc furnace six blocks tall, a twelve-block distillation column, a twenty-block pylon — every one on OUKA's grid, every item now tells you how it is used, and the Corvus Book Pro becomes a device you set down. OUKA 1.4.0 or newer is now required.
highlights: Ten plants, placed whole: Refinery Smelter 5×5×6, Still 3×3×12, Crystalliser 5×5×5, Purifier 5×4×4, Synthesizer 5×5×5, Heavy Mill 7×7×6, Dynamo 7×3×4, Transformer 4×3×5, High-Voltage Pylon 5×5×20 and Fission Core 9×9×10. Use the item on clear ground and the plant rises facing you; using any part opens it, and breaking any part returns it as one item.

They move: the furnace lowers its electrodes, lifts its roof, tips and pours; the column's sight glasses light as the boil climbs; the mill's drum turns; the dynamo's flywheel runs down when the fire goes out; a working core glows blue and its bands glow as it overheats. Working plants light the ground round them.

Bigger batches at the same cost: eight dust or four raw ore go down the refinery line and come out as twenty ingots; the Synthesizer makes four at a time; the Heavy Mill turns four ores into twelve OUKA dust. Power and water for each item are unchanged. A hopper or pipe against any part of a processing plant feeds it and takes its product.
Hold Shift over any item: every one of ASTRAEA's 284 items and blocks now says what it is, how it is used and what it needs.

Corvus Book Pro: set it down on a desk or the floor and use it there to open CorvusOS. It opens for its owner and the players they trust, keeps its links and its charge, and charges from OUKA's grid where it stands.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, Java 25 and — new in this version — OUKA 1.4.0 or newer. Machines standing in a V1.5.0 world stay as single blocks and do not work: break them and set them down again. The Heavy Mill is no longer built as a cube; its casing and rotor are what it is crafted from. Installing ASTRAEA together with Alpha is not supported.

Fixed: adding a player to the Corvus Book Pro's trust list could record the wrong player on some servers, so the cameras went on following them — an online player is now found by name, and the result is shown inside the CorvusOS window. Not in this version: the other rebuilt groups (logistics, defence, forge and gear, vehicles and the frontier, myth, furnishings) follow in later versions; the machines' sounds have been generated and checked by measurement only.

astraea.title: Logistics and the House
astraea.summary: All 21 things of Logistics and the House are rebuilt at the size of the real thing: a coining press three blocks tall, an ATM and a refrigerator as tall as you are, a compressor you can walk round, and one-block devices that move, light up and light the room while they work. OUKA 1.4.0 or newer is required, as in V1.5.2.
highlights: Seven plants, placed whole: Sovereign Mint 2×2×3, ATM 1×1×2, Scriptoria Press 2×1×2, Archive Shelf 1×1×2, Refrigerator 1×1×2, Compressor 2×2×2 and Lockdown Console 2×1×1. Use the item on clear ground and it stands facing you; any part can be used, and breaking any part returns the whole as one item.

They move: the mint's fly swings and its ram strikes the blank; the press pulls a sheet under its platen; the shelf shows the books it holds; the compressor's gauge and flywheel run while fuel burns; the console's lamps turn red when the lockdown is thrown.

Seven one-block devices with bodies of their own: a pedestal faucet that runs, a microwave whose window glows and whose lamps count the cook, a ceiling fan that turns (and stops on a redstone signal), a sender and a receiver with a carrier running in a glass tube, a safety valve whose cap lifts, and a drone pad with landing lights. Working, each lights the room.
The courier drone is a quadcopter now, with rotors, skids, running lights and its carrier slung beneath, and it faces the way it flies.

The water pipe is a pipe, the pneumatic tube has brass collars, the display case a brass frame, the holo-sign is a projector and the maglev conveyor a track. The Gold Sovereign and the Holo-Note have bodies in the hand, and each of the seven plants tells you its size and the room it needs when you hold Shift.
warnings: In a world from V1.5.2, break anything of Logistics and the House that was already placed and place it again (what it held drops); until then it may not be drawn properly or work.
A ceiling fan stopped by a redstone signal no longer clears gas. No new sounds in this release: these devices still use the game's own sounds. The rest of the 284 follow in V1.5.4 to V1.5.9.

astraea.title: Defence
astraea.summary: All 25 things of Defence are rebuilt at the size of the real thing: a missile silo eight blocks tall with its missile standing ready, an interceptor battery on its turntable, devices that move and light up as their state changes, and armour, goggles and a mask with bodies of their own when worn. OUKA 1.4.0 or newer is required, as before.
highlights: Three plants, placed whole: Missile Silo 3×3×8 (a launch table, a service tower and a missile seven blocks tall that is gone while it flies), Interceptor Battery 3×3×3 and Gas Scrubber 2×1×2. Launch and the open-sky check are from the top of the silo's middle.

Eight devices show their state: in alarm the strobe's mirror turns round its lamp and the cell monitor flashes red; the keypad and the retina scanner light green while they let a door open; an armed claymore blinks and shows its trip beam; the bear trap's jaws close on what it holds; an opened gas canister lets its gas out.

Barbed wire is a fence of pickets and strands, the spike pit a pit of poisoned stakes, the containment bulkhead a riveted wall with a hazard band, the shield wall a see-through sheet of hexagons, and the thermal laser and the shield projector are heads aimed the way they face.

Worn gear has a body: the tactical helmet, vest, leggings and boots, the night-vision goggles with their glowing lenses and the sealed mask stand out from the wearer and move with them, and look the same in the hand.
The interceptor missile and the targeting tablet have bodies in the hand, and the three plants tell you their size and the room they need when you hold Shift.
warnings: In a world from V1.5.3, break anything of Defence that was already placed and place it again (what it held drops); until then it may not be drawn properly or work.
The alarm strobe, the claymore, the bear trap and both gas canisters can no longer be pushed by pistons. No new sounds in this release. The rest of the 284 follow in V1.5.5 to V1.5.9.

tsubomi.title: The Vernal Genesis: Refined Essentials for Every Journey — Tsubomi's first release
tsubomi.summary: Tsubomi's first release: a smart wooden crate that keeps its contents, a gravity chute, a tabletop bonsai, herbal tea, a tool pouch, a brass hand lantern and copper quartz tools — and nothing heavy: not one block ticks all the time.
highlights: Wooden Smart Crate: 36 slots, and it keeps its contents when you break it and carry it. It opens and closes like a barrel and a comparator can read it. A crate cannot go inside a crate, and if the item is destroyed by fire, lava or an explosion its contents spill instead of vanishing.

Gravity Mini Chute: stack up to 128 in a column and whatever goes in at the top arrives at the bottom at once. It takes items from hoppers, droppers and item entities that fall in, hands them to a container below, or drops them if nothing is there. It has no block entity and never ticks.
Bonsai Pot: plant an oak or cherry sapling and it grows in stages, then now and then gives up a few leaves, petals or tree sap (4 tree sap make a slime ball).

Herbal Tea: dry leaves or petals over a campfire into tea leaves, then combine them with a water bottle. It gives Speed I for 45 seconds and a lingering aroma of Jump Boost I for 30 seconds, and leaves an empty bottle.

Adventurer's Tool Pouch: holds up to 9 stacks of torches, pickaxes and shovels. Press V (rebindable) to trade your selected hotbar slot with the pouch, round and round, with a short 3-tick cooldown; in the inventory it works like a bundle.
Brass Hand Lantern: hold it in your off-hand and a soft light of level 12 follows your eyes. It leaves no light behind.

Copper quartz: 2 copper ingots and 1 quartz make 2 copper quartz ingots, for a pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword with 640 durability, mining speed 6.5 and iron's mining level, repaired with the ingot.

With Cherry installed, copper quartz stands in for iron in Cherry's thermal lining and propellant canister recipes (a data pack, on by default and switchable in the data pack screen). Cherry's own recipes still work.
Nothing heavy: 1,024 crates and 1,024 chutes standing still add nothing to a tick, and carrying through 1,024 of them costs about one hundredth of the same carrying with vanilla hoppers.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
Tsubomi cannot be used together with Alpha. If any Alpha mod is installed the game will not start; remove Alpha's jars first.
The pouch key (V) works when Tsubomi is also installed on your client; on a server-only install, use the pouch by clicking in the inventory.

tsubomi.title: Tsubomi V1.0.1 — the Teleport Elevator returns
tsubomi.summary: Tsubomi V1.0.1 brings back the teleport elevator as a Tsubomi block: stack elevators in a column, jump to go up, sneak to go down.
highlights: Teleport Elevator (new block): place two or more in a column; jump on one to rise to the next above, sneak on one to drop to the next below, up to 64 blocks away.
Recipe: 6 copper quartz ingots, 1 ender pearl and 1 redstone make 2 elevators.
Light on the server: the elevator is a plain block with no block entity and no ticker, it costs nothing while nobody rides it; a blocked destination stops the trip, and spectators are not carried.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
Tsubomi cannot be used together with Alpha. If any Alpha mod is installed the game will not start; remove Alpha's jars first.

tsubomi.title: Tsubomi V1.1 — 100 new blocks
tsubomi.summary: Tsubomi V1.1 adds 100 new building blocks in 5 families of 20: sakura crystal, spiritwood, porcelain, clockwork and shrine.
highlights: 100 new blocks in 5 families of 20: crystal and amber, spiritwood and crimson bamboo, porcelain and jadeite, clockwork and brass, shrine and ritual. Every block can be crafted.
Sakura crystal: a budding crystal grows buds that ripen from small to medium to large to a cluster; the crystal lamp lights with redstone; the resonating core rings once each time it is powered.
Spiritwood is a set that does not burn, with stairs, slab, fence, gate, door, trapdoor, pressure plate and button, and an axe strips it. Crimson bamboo burns like bamboo.
Clockwork: copper casings weather like copper, pipes join each other, the pressure gauge reports the strongest redstone signal to a comparator, and the clockwork door and trapdoor open by hand.

Shrine: lanterns, a bell that rings far away, hallowed soil that speeds up the plant above it, an almost silent carpet, a loom that opens a crafting grid, a respawn anchor, and a chronometer whose signal follows the day and the moon.

Light on the server: no block has a block entity or a ticker. Only the budding crystal, the leaves, the copper casings and the hallowed soil take random ticks, and only while they grow, decay or weather.
warnings: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer and Java 25. No other mod is needed; Cherry is optional.
